tasks.short: Budget and schedule security design work.

steps.what: Total posted costs of the security design work
Sign the budget and the schedule
File the signed budget and schedule
outputs: filed copy of signed design budget v1

tasks.design: A job totals posted costs in {ERP}. The specialist budgets and schedules the security design work, signs that version, and a job files it in {PROJECT}. The total is not the budget. The schedule is of the work, not a score of a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: A total could be issued as the budget before anyone had judged it.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted costs can be totalled without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: What the work should cost, and when it should happen, is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist signs the budget and the schedule.

ambition.what: Re-total the costs when postings change, and sign a new budget.

tasks.altitude: The budget stays. Copying posted costs shrinks.

evidence.claim: The operations digest says reports and records can be a dashboard on the existing records.
Digest [S17] treats worker evaluation as high-risk, and digest [S18] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so security records are not turned into a staff evaluation.

assumptions: The schedule does not assign people by a score.
unknowns: Which costs belong to this design.
Who else must sign the budget.
research_questions: How often a posting arrives after the total.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the budget is the judgement itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every line is still judged by the specialist. The high end assumes only the posted totals are no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect fire, intruder, and other security systems.

steps.what: Inspect fire and intruder detection systems

outputs: filed copy of signed system inspection v1

tasks.design: Inspecting fire, intruder detection, and other security systems stays with the specialist, on the equipment. A job files the inspection in {DOCS} only after they sign it. The job does not test or silence an alarm.
tasks.previous_blocker: A green status could replace an inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed inspection can be filed after the visit.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the system works is still seen on the equipment.
tasks.altitude: The inspection stays. Filing the signed inspection shrinks.

reach.task: Act only on the signed inspection

evidence.claim: The operations digest says reports and records can be a dashboard on the existing records.

assumptions: The job does not operate the system.
research_questions: How often a panel status disagrees with the device.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the inspection is the inspection itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every system is still inspected by the specialist. The high end assumes only the signed inspection is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop or review specifications for security construction.

steps.what: Develop specifications for design of security systems

outputs: filed copy of signed specifications v1

tasks.design: Developing or reviewing specifications for the design or construction of security systems stays with the specialist in {DOCS}. A job files the specifications only after they sign them. The job does not issue them for construction before that signature.
tasks.previous_blocker: A copied specification could go to construction without a review.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed specification can be the version construction uses.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the specification is fit to build is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist develops, reviews, and signs.

ambition.what: Issue a specification for construction only after this version is signed.

tasks.altitude: The specification stays. Filing the signed version shrinks.

reach.task: Build only from the signed specifications

evidence.claim: The operations digest says a draft must work from approved sources, and a named person signs.

assumptions: The job does not write the specification.
unknowns: Which codes the specification must meet.
research_questions: How often a review comment is missed in the next draft.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the specification is the writing and the review, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the specialist still writes and reviews the specification. The high end assumes only the signed copy is no longer retyped. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview witnesses or suspects about a security breach.

steps.what: Interview witnesses or suspects about the breach
Identify the persons responsible and establish the losses
Decide whether to pursue prosecutions or restitution

outputs: filed copy of signed interview finding v1

tasks.design: Interviewing witnesses or suspects, identifying persons responsible for a security breach, establishing losses, and deciding whether to pursue prosecutions or restitution stays with the specialist. A job files the finding in {DOCS} only after they sign it. The interview is not scored, and the job does not name a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: A score could name a person before the interview.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed finding can be filed for counsel.
tasks.still_hard: Who is responsible, and what to do next, is still a judgement after the interview.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist interviews and signs the finding.
tasks.altitude: The interview stays. Filing the signed finding shrinks.

reach.learn: That the file did not identify anyone

evidence.claim: Digest [S20] bars a solely automated decision with significant effect, so a finding about a person stays with the specialist.
Digest [S19] bans emotion recognition at work since 2 February 2025, so a recording is not scored for how a person looks or sounds.
Digest [S21] says a score a decision-maker draws strongly on counts as the decision, so this design produces no threat score and no score of a person.
Digest [S22] says a data protection assessment is mandatory for employee monitoring, so an automated watch of named staff is not built.

research_questions: How often a witness will not be recorded, by their own choice.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the interview is the interview itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the stored standard list or the drawing index when it changes, and clear drafts the specialist rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every interview is still conducted by the specialist. The high end assumes only the signed finding is no longer copied. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The security specialist spends the week on the site, the incident, and the decision. Filing a signed note can move. No model scores a person, watches staff, or changes a live security system.
reach: A client sees only the criteria or the finding the specialist signed.
A supervisor gets an emergency note after the specialist has already responded.
skills_to_grow: Tell a stored incident count from a threat decision.
Refuse a view that scores or tracks named staff.
role.ambitious_version: A signed test or a signed recommendation can be filed the same day, and the specialist still decides it.
